searchText: hey guys, just a heads up... al avila will be available in our dugout at 3:30pm today. there's no announcement or major news of any kind... just thought it would be good to give the media a chance to talk to him since the team has been gone for 20 of the last 26 games. please feel free to pass along word to your cohorts. matthew b. mowery et al
